headline: Nvidia's $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech's AI chip buildout
snapshot: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips. The larger angle is AI infrastructure: compute capacity, chip access and data-center economics are increasingly determining which companies can scale products for enterprise and government customers.
